title: Gauss--Manin connections extend to holonomic coadmissible D-cap-modules
summary: We prove that the pushforwards of Gauss--Manin connections on smooth rigid analytic varieties along Zariski-open immersions are coadmissible and holonomic over Ardakov--Wadsley's sheaf D-cap of infinite order differential operators. This may be viewed as a rigid analytic variant of the classical theorem of Griffiths, Deligne, and Katz that Gauss-Manin systems have regular singularities after compactification.
